Overview of Murcia Region (Murcia)

Murcia Region (Murcia) is located in the Murcia region of Spain, with its prefectural capital at Murcia. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Casco Histórico & Plaza Mayor, Cathedral & Alcázar, Traditional Mercado Central, Evening Paseo & tapas quarter.

RegionMurcia
Capital cityMurcia
Cities & municipalities25
Primary transport hubMurcia Central Station (Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Murcia Region

Connected via Renfe AVE / Avlo / Ouigo / Iryo high-speed rail and ALSA intercity coaches. Use our Renfe AVE, Iryo & Ouigo High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Murcia

When visiting cities across Murcia, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Tapas & raciones
  • Jamón Ibérico de Bellota
  • Tortilla Española
  • Churros con chocolate
  • Regional DO wines

Best time to visit Murcia

Best time to visit Murcia: Apr–Jun, Sep–Nov.
